frontMatter.title: National Napping Day… but Monday Club Night won’t wait!
frontMatter.summary: National Napping Day or not, Monday Club Night is on at Claremont: Grade 2 Ladies Navan ‘B’ vs Navan ‘A’, two courts available from 8:30pm, and Juveniles at 6:30pm (Girls) and 7:30pm (Boys).

prev.title: Club Update: League Final Bound & Cup Wins
prev.summary: A week of mixed results: playoff exits for Grade 4 Mixed and Grade 3 Mixed, three Cup wins on the bounce, and Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ reach the League Final vs Kildalkey on Tuesday 10th March in Wilkinstown. No Club Night this Wednesday due to MBA Mixed League Finals.

next.title: Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ Team Finish Runners-Up in League Final
next.summary: Our Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ team—Alo, Elaine, Anneke and Gerard—finished as runners-up in last night’s league final in Wilkinstown after a strong season, with a standout performance from Elaine Maher serving 21 consecutive points.
